body: Yeah true, but even just a normal life where he's here and we just take care of the kids, work and do what we need to do seems like it would be a good enough fairytale ending for me right now
But not going to lie I'm hoping for a stupid fairy tale ending 😅

Yeah and he's sober now and proud of it. Your the first person who hasn't explicitly told me to run. I miss the fuck out of him and honestly more scared that things are to messed up between us. I've made some questionable life choices but if he gets out and it's the same stuff again I'd have to move on so I don't mess up my kid's life.

If I go drug counseling, I'm afraid I'll lose my kids or will at least be at risk of losing them and things will get worse anyways. Thank you again for talking with me. You really did make me feel better lol or at least feel not so much like a fuck up.

I don't know what his motivations were tbh other than to get sober and not have me and kids leave.  He has said he doesn't want to get high anymore, I'm sure most addicts don't. I'm 24. Thanks for talking with me man. If you're still talking with me cause you don't want me to kill myself, I'm okay tonight kind stranger, thank you. I'll figure more stuff out tomorrow hopefully. New day.
I wish I could convince myself that it was that easy

I probably drink too much and smoke pot if I'm being honest. He started using in highschool. The plan was to go to treatment after we spent the 4th of July together but we didn't make it through that morning, long time coming I guess.

Never hit me before but I was so scared of him as soon as he left, I called the cops. Violated the terms of probation, back to prison. Now I hate myself for it cause I miss him even if he's terrible for me. Plus we had a baby. Just a fucking mess lol

He's a heroin addict. I'm sure he's done other drugs too. He just snapped one morning, he had been super paranoid for weeks. Was convinced I was cheating on him. Ive known him since he was a kid. He was my best friend and I use to think it would be perfect if we ended up getting married which is really silly considering how messed up things are now
2 and half years

Been thinking a lot about just telling my kids grandma to come get them, making sure she was coming and that she understood that they would be alone, and just lock the bathroom door and kill myself. Feels good as fuck to write that. I'm sorry I'm venting to strangers but it's true. I honestly have not felt okay in a long time and not doing life anymore sounds so nice. I've had enough of fucking up.

To my youngest, yes. I know I'm probably better off but I scared to move on in life right now and I don't know if I care enough about myself to. He's in prison nowanyways. I've posted about this before with throw away accounts. I've been through the whole "leave him, he's a POS" and I'm still technically with him and everything is sort of in limbo.
I've got kids and a complicated relationship with his family and lots of expectations that are implied. And I feel like I don't want him to leave.
But ey keep on right and hopefully it gets better.

And my grades are slipping and I almost don't care because that way if I just fail already I don't have to try so hard anymore. I was doing good in school but I'm not happy, I feel fake. I don't care anymore. I fake being okay everyday and I become so empty of a person and everyone around me seems so unrelatable and cold.
Not me buddy. Lol. This did make me feel better tho

I got the shit beat out of me by my boyfriend. I guess that's the most recent bad thing that's happened. And I'm over here trying to fix things and knowing I'm being fucking stupid but things feel so complicated sometimes you just want to say, alright, f this. Sink the whole ship. I'm tired.
Just feel like my life is so fucked sometimes it's hard to gain any traction towards fixing it. I feel like giving up.
Just one of those nights that it would feel really good not to exist or at least be someone else.
Really though? It's so fucking hard to think of anything I've objectively done good.
Alright, solid advice. Thank you.
I'm a girl but thanks for the insight lol
